app.description: Price comparison across marketplaces: the real price, shipping included, with price-drop alerts.

home.title: The real price, before you buy.
home.lead: Prixly works out what an Amazon or AliExpress product really costs you (price, shipping and delivery time) and lets you know when it drops. Looking for a product but not sure where? Type its name.

howItWorks.step1Text: In the Amazon or AliExpress app: {action}. Or paste the link in the field above.
howItWorks.step2Text: Price + shipping = the total you will actually pay, with delivery time, rating and price history.
howItWorks.step3Text: Prixly checks the price every 6 hours and sends you a notification when it drops or goes below your target price.

linkForm.label: Product link or name
linkForm.placeholder: Paste an Amazon or AliExpress link, or search for a product…

login.title: Private access
login.text: Enter the access code to use Prixly on this device.
login.label: Access code

watched.title: Watched products
watched.intro: Prices checked every 6 hours. You get a notification when one of them drops.
watched.empty: You're not watching any product yet. Open a product page and tap {action}.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.intro: For each watched product, Prixly sends you a notification when the total (price + shipping) drops by at least 5% or €0.50, hits a new low, or goes below your target price.
notifications.sent: Sent. Nothing received? Make sure Chrome notifications aren't silenced in your Android settings.

install.androidText: Install Prixly: it will show up in the {share} menu of the Amazon and AliExpress apps.
install.chromeHint: In Chrome: menu ⋮ → {action} (not “Add to Home screen”).
install.iosText: iOS doesn't allow sharing to a web app: copy the product link and paste it here. To receive price alerts, add Prixly to your Home Screen (Share → {action}).
install.desktopText: Open Prixly in Chrome and install it: it will show up in the {share} menu of the Amazon and AliExpress apps. On a computer, just paste the link.

push.enabled: 🔔 Alerts are on for this device.
push.enable: 🔔 Turn on alerts for this device
push.denied: 🔕 Notifications are blocked for this site: allow them in your browser settings to receive alerts.
push.unsupported: 🔕 This browser can't receive notifications. On iPhone, add Prixly to your Home Screen (Share → Add to Home Screen) and open it from there.
push.serverDisabled: 🔕 Notifications aren't configured on the server (missing VAPID keys).
push.swUnavailable: Service worker unavailable (it only runs in the production build).
push.notConfigured: Notifications aren't configured on the server.

verdict.highText: {pct}% above the average ({avg}) {period}: better wait for a drop.
verdict.dubiousText: The struck-through price ({list}) was never charged in {days} of tracking: the highest price seen is {highest}.
verdict.realText: The product was indeed sold at {list} or more during tracking.
verdict.pendingWatched: It takes {n} days of tracking to know whether the struck-through price ({list}) was really charged.
verdict.pendingNotWatched: Watch the price for {n} days to know whether the struck-through price ({list}) was really charged.

product.notifyBelow: Notify me when the total goes below
product.alertInfo: You'll also get an alert for every drop of at least 5% (or €0.50) and every new lowest price.
product.watchedSince: watched since {date}, checked automatically every 6 hours
product.autoChecked: The price is checked automatically every 6 hours.
product.watchToTrack: Watch this product to track its price automatically and get notified of drops.

offers.title: Price on other Amazon stores
offers.intro: Compare this product's price on Amazon Germany, Spain, Italy, the Netherlands and Belgium.
offers.footnote: Item price only, checked {when}. Check shipping to France and delivery time on each site; VAT is adjusted to the French rate at checkout.

search.title: Where to find it?
search.lead: Search for a product on every platform, new or used, in one go.
search.label: Product to search for
search.foundText: For an Amazon or AliExpress product (marked “Prixly tracking”), share it to Prixly or paste its link on the home page: total cost with shipping, price verdict, tracking and price-drop alerts.

ebay.title: eBay listings
ebay.aiSorted: Sorted by AI: grouped by product, accessories and parts set aside.
ebay.none: No eBay listing that ships to France for this search.
ebay.noMatch: No listing really matches the search: try more specific terms.
ebay.hidden: {n} listing set aside | {n} listings set aside

assistant.toggle: Not sure what to look for? Describe what you need to the assistant
assistant.label: Not sure what to look for? Describe what you need: the assistant tells you what to search for and what to check.
assistant.placeholder: E.g. a cordless vacuum for a small flat with a cat, under €200
assistant.check: What to check in the listing

results.title: Best offers found
results.searchingHint: Searching eBay and the web, checking prices, then ranking them for your need. This can take 30 seconds.
results.none: No offer found. Try one of the searches above or refine your need.
results.noSources: For real results, set up eBay keys or a Groq key (LLM_API_KEY) with the default model.

results.unranked: AI ranking failed: here are the offers found, unranked.
results.webQuota: Free web search quota (Groq) reached for today: results are incomplete. Add eBay keys to still get listings.
